title: Add up a list
objective: Keep a running total in a changing name, and add each item in a list to it inside a loop.

body.text: Many programs keep a running total. Make the total changing, so it can grow, then add each item to it inside a repeat for each loop. The total must start at 0, because a total starts from nothing before any item is added.

body.title: Total the scores
body.code:
make changing total equal to 0
make scores equal to a list of 1, 2, 3
repeat for each s in scores
    increase total by s
say total

body.prompt: The loop only shows each score, so the total stays 0. Make it print 15.
body.starter:
make changing total equal to 0
make scores equal to a list of 4, 5, 6
repeat for each s in scores
    say s
say total
body.solution:
make changing total equal to 0
make scores equal to a list of 4, 5, 6
repeat for each s in scores
    increase total by s
say total
